paṭicodeti.cp: paṭi + cud + e. blames in return; reproves.
paṭicodeti.p: [Pati+cuda+ṇe+ti] (kri) Google Translate (1) (a) Blame-complaint; (B) Warns, urges, and urges. (2) Again, blame. And again, these would mean that you have to spend for these processes.
a: ပဋိစောဒေတိ(ကြိ)

D: Paṭicodeti，（paṭi + cud + e），倒责备回，责备。 【过】 ~esi。 【过分】 ~dita。【独】 ~detvā。（p192）

DOP: paṭicodeti pr. 3 sg. [ cf BHS praticodayati], reproves, admonishes (in return); Vin I 43, 26 (ye tumhe imāya gāthāya codenti … te tumhe imāya gāthāya ~etha) ≠ Ud 45, 9 ; Vin IV 84, 26 (āsādanāpekkho ti iminā imaṃ codessāmi sāressāmi ~essāmi paṭisāressāmi); 216, 32 (yā pana bhikkhunī jānaṃ pārājikaṃ dhammaṃ ajjhāpannaṃ bhikkhuniṃ n’ ev’ attanā ~eyya na gaṇassa āroceyya; 217, 10 : na sayaṃ codeyya); 217, 1 (no ca kho attanā ~essaṃ na gaṇassa ārocessan ti, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee ~eyyaṃ); A II 9, 6 (tatra vata maṃ samaṇo vā brāhmaṇō vā … koci vā lokasmiṃ sahadhammena ~essatī ti); Peṭ 33, 9 (maṃ koci sahadhammena ~issatī ti n’ etaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati, eds so ); Pj II 298, 10 (yadā maṃ garahissati tadā naṃ etena ~essāmī ti); 520, 10 (bhikkhū Ānanda te manusse evaṃ ~entū ti); — aor. 3 sg. paṭicodesi, D II 272, 1 (te … Gopako devaputto ~esi; Sv 706, 31 : ~esī ti sāresi); — absol. paṭicodetvā, Sv 189, 7 (anucchavikaṃ te etan ti attānaṃ ~etvā); — pp paṭicodita , mfn. , reproved, admonished; D II 272, 13 (tesaṃ bhante Gopakena devaputtena ~ānaṃ); — fpp paṭicodetabba, mfn. , Vism 283, 30 (attanā va attā paṭicodetabbo); Pj II 520, 13 .
